text_block_list.text:
After running a great race against Smart 
Falcon in the Teio Sho and gathering 
valuable data, Transcend asks her how she 
manages to stay smiling.

"Because it's the one and only thing I can 
do." Even when told that, Transcend 
couldn't bring herself to see it the same 
way.

Though all the data on the Big Three was 
gathered, she felt as if she were back at 
square one. Not even racing against strong 
foes thrilled her anymore, and she deeply 
realized the importance of daily life.

For Transcend's sake, the Trainer 
suggested having disaster victims watch 
her race.

The Mile Championship Nambu Hai, held near 
the hardest-hit area. Will she be able to 
reconnect the frayed threads of her heart 
there?
